    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in grid))

        return out
    stripe = stripe_rows[0]

    occupied = [r for r in range(stripe + 1, h)
                if any(grid[r][c] != bg for c in range(w))]
    if occupied:
        r = min(occupied) - 1
        if r > stripe:
            out[r] = [8] * w
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max({v for row in grid for v in row},
             key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    stripe = next(r for r in range(h)
                  if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != bg)
    # Locate the non-background object, excluding the full-width stripe.
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] != bg and r != stripe]
    if not cells:
        return out

    top = min(r for r, c in cells)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in cells)
    left = min(c for r, c in cells)
    right = max(c for r, c in cells)
    obj = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r, c in cells]

    if bottom < stripe:  # object above stripe: move it down next to stripe
        dr = stripe - 1 - bottom
        for r, c, v in obj:
            out[r][c] = bg
        for r, c, v in obj:
            out[r + dr][c] = v
        out[top + dr - 1] = [8] * w
    else:  # object below stripe: move it up next to stripe
        dr = top - stripe - 1
        for r, c, v in obj:
            out[r][c] = bg
        for r, c, v in obj:
            out[r - dr][c] = v
        out[bottom - dr + 1] = [8] * w
    return out
